card.name: Over-the-counter and regulatory phrases
card.fires_on: Words inside the phrase "over the counter" or "nonprescription", and words in FDA or regulator names and medical-device wording. It fires on the word before the phrase finishes.

modes.label: Over-the-counter phrase
modes.description: The words over, the, or -the inside "over-the-counter", and the middle of "nonprescription".
modes.example: You might wonder why you need a prescription if many PPIs are available<< over>> the counter.

modes.label: FDA and device regulation
modes.description: Words in agency names or device regulation, like Food, FDA, devices, cleared.
modes.example: safety complaints to governing bodies like the U.S.<< Food>> and Drug Administration.
